about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Poha Flattened Rice with Peanuts and Lime
recipes.summary: Light, turmeric-yellow flattened rice with peanuts, curry leaves and lime.
steps: Rinse the flattened rice in a sieve until just softened and set aside to drain.
Fry the mustard seeds, peanuts in the oil for 2 minutes, until the seeds pop and the peanuts brown.
Add the diced onion, chillies and diced potato and cook for 8 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in turmeric, salt and the rice and cook for 3 minutes until hot through.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha Potato Stuffed Flatbread
recipes.summary: Whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato, griddled until blistered.
steps: Knead the flour, salt and water for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, then mash with cumin, garam masala, chilli and coriander.
Roll each dough ball, fill with potato, pinch closed and roll out thin again.
Cook on a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side, then brush with ghee and cook until golden and blistered.
Serve hot, straight from the pan, with yoghurt alongside.
notes: Use oil in place of ghee for dairy-free.

recipes.title: Arepas with Black Beans and Avocado
recipes.summary: Crisp-outside, soft-inside cornmeal cakes split and stuffed with beans and avocado.
steps: Mix the cornmeal, salt and water into a soft dough and rest for 5 minutes.
Shape into 8 thick discs.
Cook in the oil in a pan for 5 minutes a side, until a crisp golden crust forms.
Bake at 180C for 10 minutes until the arepas sound hollow when tapped.
Warm the beans for 5 minutes until hot and mash the avocado with lime.
Split the arepas and fill with beans, avocado and feta.
notes: Gluten-free as long as the cornmeal is.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki Cabbage Pancake
recipes.summary: Savoury Osaka-style cabbage pancake with sweet sauce, mayonnaise and bonito flakes.
steps: Mix the flour, dashi, eggs, cabbage and spring onion into a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and spoon in the batter, topping with the bacon.
Cook for 6 minutes until golden underneath, flip and cook 5 minutes until the bacon is cooked and the middle is firm.
Brush with sauce, drizzle with mayonnaise and scatter with bonito.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancake until the centre is fully set and the bacon is crisp.
Contains pork, egg, fish and gluten.

recipes.title: Full Australian Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Eggs, bacon, grilled tomato, smashed avocado, mushrooms and toast.
steps: Grill the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Fry the halved tomatoes and mushrooms in the oil for 8 minutes until browned and soft.
Fry the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Mash the avocado with lemon and pepper.
Toast the bread until golden and plate everything together.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm and yolks thickened.

recipes.title: Spiced Lamb and Hummus Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Spiced minced lamb over hummus with tomato, cucumber and parsley.
steps: Fry the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains.
Stir in the spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Spread the hummus into bowls.
Top with lamb, diced tomato, cucumber and parsley, and squeeze over lemon.
notes: Food safety: minced lamb must reach 75°C inside, with no pink.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese and Smoked Salmon Rye Toast
recipes.summary: Rye toast with cottage cheese, smoked trout, cucumber and dill, high in protein.
steps: Toast the rye until crisp at the edges.
Spread with cottage cheese.
Top with sliced cucumber and flaked salmon.
Finish with dill, lemon juice and pepper until each slice is generously covered.
notes: Smoked fish is not recommended for pregnant people unless heated to 75°C.

recipes.title: Tortilla Espanola Breakfast Wedges
recipes.summary: Thick potato and onion omelette, cut into wedges, good hot or cold.
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly and fry gently in the oil with the onion for 15 minutes until completely tender.
Beat the eggs with salt and fold in the drained potato mix.
Cook in a 24cm pan over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until the base sets.
Flip with a plate and cook 5 minutes until the middle is set and no longer wet.
Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Most of the oil is drained away.

recipes.title: Lebanese Manakish Zaatar Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft flatbread topped with thyme, sesame and olive oil, a Lebanese bakery breakfast.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and 1 tbsp oil and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Rest the dough covered until doubled, then divide into 4 balls and roll to 20cm rounds.
Stir the zaatar with the remaining oil and spread over the dough.
Bake at 240C for 10 minutes, until the edges are golden and the base is crisp.
Serve with cucumber and tomato.

recipes.title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Wakame
recipes.summary: Quick Japanese morning soup of dashi, miso, silken tofu and seaweed.
steps: Soak the wakame in cold water for 5 minutes until soft, then drain.
Heat the dashi to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes until steaming, without boiling.
Dissolve the miso in a ladleful of the hot dashi and stir back in.
Add the tofu and wakame and heat for 2 minutes until hot through.
Ladle into bowls and serve with sliced spring onion on top.
notes: Contains soy and fish if the dashi is made with bonito.

recipes.title: Khao Tom Thai Rice Soup with Pork
recipes.summary: Gentle ginger rice soup with pork meatballs, a comforting Thai breakfast.
steps: Simmer the stock with sliced ginger for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Mix the pork with garlic, fish sauce and pepper and roll into small balls.
Drop the balls into the stock and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Add the rice and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Serve topped with spring onion, fried garlic and coriander.
notes: Food safety: pork balls must reach 75°C with no pink centre.

recipes.title: Minestrone Genovese with Pesto
recipes.summary: Chunky vegetable and bean soup finished with a spoon of basil pesto.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the potato, tomatoes, stock and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is almost tender.
Add the zucchini, beans and pasta and simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Serve with the pesto stirred through.
notes: Pesto contains cheese and nuts; use vegetarian-hard-cheese pesto for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Fattoush Pomegranate and Sumac Salad
recipes.summary: Crunchy salad with toasted pita, sumac dressing and pomegranate.
steps: Brush the pita with oil and bake at 200C for 5 minutes until crisp and golden.
Whisk lemon juice, sumac and 3 tbsp oil.
Chop the vegetables and toss with mint and dressing.
Break the pita over the top.

recipes.title: Spiced Chickpea Caesar Salad with Vegan Dressing
recipes.summary: Crisp cos with roasted chickpeas, garlic croutons and a creamy cashew dressing.
steps: Toss the chickpeas with oil and paprika and roast at 200C for 20 minutes, until crisp.
Cube the bread, toss with oil and bake alongside for 8 minutes until golden.
Blend the cashews, lemon, garlic, mustard, water and salt until silky.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with chickpeas and croutons.

recipes.title: Thai Green Papaya Style Cucumber Som Tam
recipes.summary: Crunchy cucumber and carrot crushed with lime, chilli and peanuts.
steps: Crush the garlic and chilli in a mortar to a rough paste.
Add the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add the sliced vegetables and bruise gently until they release their juices.
Top with crushed peanuts.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower Salad with Currants and Lemon
recipes.summary: Roasted cauliflower with currants, almonds and parsley under a tangy dressing.
steps: Toss florets with 2 tbsp oil, cumin and salt and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Toast the almonds for 3 minutes until golden.
Whisk the lemon, honey and remaining oil.
Toss everything together while the cauliflower is warm.

recipes.title: Colcannon Irish Mashed Potato and Cabbage
recipes.summary: Creamy mash folded with buttery kale and spring onions.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Simmer the shredded cabbage in water for 5 minutes until tender, then drain.
Warm the milk with the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Fold the milk, butter and cabbage into the mash until smooth and creamy.
notes: Dairy-free: use olive oil and oat milk.

recipes.title: Honey Roast Carrots with Cumin and Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted carrots with cumin and tangy yoghurt.
steps: Toss the carrots with oil, honey, cumin and salt and roast at 200C for 30 minutes, until caramelised and tender.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon zest.
Spoon the yoghurt onto a plate, top with carrots and dill.

recipes.title: Elote Mexican Street Corn Off the Cob
recipes.summary: Charred corn tossed with mayonnaise, lime, chilli and crumbled cheese.
steps: Char the corn in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until blackened in spots.
Cut the kernels from the cobs with a sharp knife.
Mix with mayonnaise, lime juice and chilli.
Top with cheese and coriander.

recipes.title: Romesco Roasted Red Capsicum and Almond Sauce
recipes.summary: Smoky capsicum, almond and sherry vinegar sauce for grilled vegetables and fish.
steps: Roast the capsicums at 220C for 20 minutes, until blackened, then cool in a bag and peel.
Toast the almonds for 3 minutes until golden.
Blend with the garlic, vinegar, paprika, salt and capsicum, then drizzle in the oil until smooth.
